From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Tuesday, February 23, 2016 9:17 AM
To: Mark Pieper <mpieper@relativitysports.com>
Subject: Re: Checking in 
 
Thank you.

From: Mark Pieper <mpieper@relativitysports.com>
Sent: Monday, February 22, 2016 10:11 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Re: Checking in 
 
Saw this article. Nice piece about him
On Feb 22, 2016, at 11:00 AM, Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:

It's Anthony from Detroit. Just checking in to see if you could get me in touch with Diego Bentz in the coming weeks. I'm working on a big piece about the Miguel Cabrera trade from 2007 for Opening Day and would like to talk to him.
Here is the feature story I wrote on Jordan for Sunday's Free Press: http://www.freep.com/longform/sports/mlb/tigers/2016/02/20/detroit-tigers-jordan-zimmermann/80690952/
11 is fine. Just check in at the security desk and they’ll call upstairs.

From: Anthony Fenech [mailto:anthonyfenech@hotmail.com] 
Sent: Monday, January 14, 2019 9:13 AM
To: Vita, Matthew <Matthew.Vita@washpost.com>
Subject: Checking in
Hey Matt, It's Anthony. Just checking in about today. Let me know when and where is good for you. I know things might be thrown off with the weather, so I'm flexible with time.
